senses.gloss: m. (v. הֲבִירָא; Syr. חברא, P. Sm. 1185) mist, darkness.
units: <cite ref="Tamid 32a:76">Tam. 32ᵃ</cite> <he>דפרשי בה׳</he> which travel in the dark (fog).

<cite ref="Keritot 5b">Ker. 5ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>בביתא דה׳</he> Ar. (ed. <he>דבהתא</he>) in a half-dark house; <cite ref="Horayot 12a:2">Hor. 12ᵃ</cite> <he>דה׳</he> Ar. a. En Yakob (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 1, ed. <he>דח׳</he>).

<cite ref="Pesachim 112b:10">Pes. 112ᵇ</cite> <he>לא ליזיל בה׳ בלא מסאני</he> Ms. M. (ed. <cite ref="E00520"><he>הכרא</he></cite> a. oth. differ., v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) one must not walk without shoes in the dark (twilight).
